_source: Built from the facts of CBP ruling N350953 (2025-07-30, dev split): CBP held Thailand. Product written by the agent from the facts, no model draft (D782). Target China (reverse probe: away from a non-China origin); plant capabilities for China and all costs are assumptions. No later ruling on a changed setup, so there is no backtest.

product.name: Lithium iron phosphate prismatic battery cell, 314 Ah
product.description: A 3.2 V prismatic cell in a rigid aluminium case, made from electrode materials, foils, separator and electrolyte.

components.name: Anode and cathode active materials, binders and solvents
Aluminium and copper foils, separator and electrolyte
Aluminium cell case, cover and connectors

operations.name: Mix electrode slurries, coat them on foil, dry, calender and laser-slit the electrodes
Wind electrodes and separators into a jelly roll, weld tabs to the cover and laser-weld the case
Pre-charge, inject electrolyte, age and hermetically seal the cell
